strengths: World frame arrives before the named character: graduation/recruitment season, labs emptying, job-result messages.
Only Zhou Ye must be remembered by name.
Zero-paper pressure and PhD status leak through interview conflict.
Reliability appears as an action pattern and an unfinished limitation, not a personality summary.
The tone is restrained and leaves room for a long Campbell arc.
risks: Interview Q&A remains a relatively static form.
Technical details may still ask too much attention before emotional attachment forms.
Final-interview notification gives a tidy micro-payoff that should not be overread as reward for virtue.

strengths: Immediate conflict: the interviewer changes the conditions and asks her to retract a conclusion.
Song Nan's speed, humor, confidence and willingness to delete her own answer appear through action.
Industry world is legible even without prior technical knowledge.
Dialogue and whiteboard changes produce stronger scene motion than the old profile-like chapters.
Her weakness is already visible: speed can become over-answering.
risks: The scene can drift toward a job-interview competence showcase if too many answers land cleanly.
Q&A rhythm is still highly structured and needs interruptions/awkwardness in revision.
The final line about statistics stopping decisions is close to a polished thesis line and should probably be weakened in v2.

comparative_judgment.reason: B is more immediately entertaining; A better establishes the novel's larger world and slower moral texture. The project should not choose solely on first-page excitement.
current_learning: The old opening failed because characters were introduced as analyzed subjects. Both new probes work better because the reader first watches them deal with pressure.
Name overload drops automatically when the scene is centered on one entrance rather than an ensemble briefing.
Background can be delivered by interviewers, forms, empty labs, job notices and what the character refuses to overclaim.
Cinematic quality comes from spatial action and pressure, not from adding decorative visual description.

next_test.purpose: Test a third entrance driven by social/institutional friction rather than technical or interview performance, using an office already in motion before Luo is introduced.
next_test.gate: Do not restore the old opening sequence until at least one non-interview entrance also works.
